address: 2F, Yodoyabashi odona, 4-1-1 Imabashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 541-0042, Japan
bio: Piped baroque music and service on trolleys recall the goodness of French restaurants in the old days. As befits a restaurant managed by a Yamanashi winery, grape leaves adorn the walls and the company’s own wines are served. A devotee of classic cuisine, the chef excels in dishes baked in pie crusts, and is generous with sauces. The fruit that decorates the tables can be made into crêpes Suzette....
